about: Top 5 wild GTA 6 finds from launch week, counted down: a bent 'scoliosis' car (@typicalgamer), a man in a suit who gets in your car and says 'Stay calm and drive' (Collateral, 2004; @Testyment), a giant crab that jumps Jason at home (@nerpah), the Skunk Ape up close (@Lazarbeam), and the UFO that takes you yourself (@Syndicate). The last line ends mid-sentence and line 1 completes it, so the loop replays. Commentary mode (SAFE-EDIT rule 10): five muted creator clips, facecams and captions cropped out, credit in the description only; background plates from GTA VI: An Extended Look (rule 11). Delta.
